scripts.dev: docker compose up -d db && concurrently "pnpm -F @frostleaf/backend dev" "pnpm -F @frostleaf/frontend dev"
scripts.build: pnpm -F @frostleaf/shared build && pnpm -F @frostleaf/backend build && pnpm -F @frostleaf/frontend build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -F @frostleaf/shared typecheck && pnpm -F @frostleaf/backend typecheck && pnpm -F @frostleaf/frontend typecheck
